question: Which of the following books is authored by Sanjaya Baru?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Accidental Prime Minister.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Accidental Prime Minister: The Making and Unmaking of Manmohan Singh is a 2014 memoir by Indian policy authored by Sanjaya Baru, who was Prime Minister Manmohan Singh's media advisor from May 2004 to August 2008.**
 
• Published by Penguin India, the book alleges that Singh was not entirely in control of his cabinet—or even the Prime Minister's Office (PMO).
 
• A film adaptation of the book with Anupam Kher portraying the role of Singh was released on 11 January 2019.
 
• The film garnered a lot of attention and stirred controversy. 
 
• In the wake of the 2019 Lok Sabha elections, the movie was cited as propaganda by the then ruling party, BJP. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ace248e39ac654039ee6e1c2ad75ebd75aab71378b32fc838d0ea4834b9a09f8.png] 

 
• **The Paradoxical Prime Minister Book, Inglorious Empire, Nehru: The Invention of India Book authored by Shashi Tharoor Book.**
